2607.20582.title: Bayesian uncertainty estimation improves clinical decision making in medical AI agents
2607.20582.paper_summary: Machine learning models for medical image analysis typically lack a reliable measure of confidence, limiting their use in ambiguous or atypical cases. Here we show that Monte Carlo dropout, applied to a multi-task chest-radiograph classifier (eight thoracic findings, 137,593 training images), provides an epistemic uncertainty signal that tracks generalisation across training-set scales and flags confident yet error-prone predictions. Adding this signal to the point prediction raised error-detection AUROC from 0.74 to 0.77 ($Δ$AUROC +0.023, 95% CI [+0.014, +0.033]). In a controlled 2x2 factorial experiment, a clinical-decision-support agent exploited this uncertainty only when it was delivered as a binary error-risk flag rather than as raw scores, cutting confident misdiagnoses on unreliable findings from 8.5% to 2.7%. Epistemic uncertainty estimation thus carries decision-relevant information beyond point predictions, but its value for downstream agents depends on how it is communicated.
2607.20582.paper_summary_zh: 機器學習模型在醫學影像分析中通常缺乏可靠的信心指標，這限制了它們在模糊或非典型案例中的使用。<lb/>在這裡，我們展示了將蒙地卡羅隨機失活應用於多任務胸部X光分類器（八種胸腔發現，137,593張訓練影像）提供了一種信念不確定性信號，該信號能夠追蹤訓練集規模的泛化並標示出自信但容易出錯的預測。<lb/>將這一信號添加到點預測中，使得錯誤檢測的AUROC從0.74提高到0.77（$Δ$AUROC +0.023，95% CI [+0.014, +0.033]）。<lb/>在一個受控的2x2因子實驗中，臨床決策支持代理僅在將這一不確定性以二元錯誤風險標誌的形式傳遞時才利用它，而不是以原始分數的形式，將對不可靠發現的自信誤診率從8.5%降低到2.7%。<lb/>因此，信念不確定性估計攜帶了超越點預測的決策相關信息，但其對下游代理的價值取決於其傳達方式。
